chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from al-'Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two of them, peace be upon them, who said:
I asked him about meat: may it be taken out of the Haram? He said: Nothing is taken out from it except the hump, after three days.

key_terms.السَّنَامُ: the hump, named here as the exception
key_terms.اللَّحْمِ: the meat being asked about in the ruling
key_terms.الْحَرَمِ: the sacred precinct from which the meat is not to be removed
key_terms.ثَلَاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ: the period after which the stated exception applies
key_terms.لَا يُخْرَجُ: it is not to be taken out or removed

ai.seo_question: Can sacrificial meat be taken out of the Haram in Mina?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the meat of sacrificial animals within the Haram during hajj. It indicates that nothing should be taken out from it, except the hump, after three days, reflecting a restriction tied to the rites and sanctity of the sacred precinct.
